related_issues.reason: Closed issue about build-system.requires being resolved incorrectly (a build-requirement resolution bug, different symptom: no solution found, not prerelease policy being ignored). Useful context only.

rationale: The reporter says --prerelease, --prerelease-package, UV_PRERELEASE, tool.uv.prerelease and uv.toml prerelease have no effect on build-system.requires resolution after the 0.12 if-necessary default change, and that the flags are silently ignored. The uv pre-release compatibility docs state that --prerelease allow considers pre-releases 'for every package', so a flag documented to apply to every package not applying to build requirements (and failing silently) is a misbehaviour against a documented contract, not a design choice the docs spell out. The docs have no page saying build dependencies are exempt from prerelease settings. Reproduction is straightforward from the issue (a build-system requires with a prerelease-only solution), so no MRE is needed. No duplicate found in search. Confidence is medium because the 'every package' wording is the only contract, and the reporter's ask partly reads as a new option (--build-prerelease), which would be an enhancement.
